Mature Dutch Smoushond, compact sturdy square body, about39cm at withers. Broad shortish slightly domed head with clear stop; broad muzzle about half skull length, black nose, tight lips, round dark brown eyes visible through eyebrows. Small rather high-set natural drooping ears leaning slightly toward cheeks. Rather short muscular neck, straight back, mildly arched loin, broad moderately deep chest, modest tuck. Four strong straight coherent limb courses with moderate angulation, small neat round cat feet. Harsh coarse straight shaggy4–7cm straw-yellow coat with sufficient undercoat, darker yellow ears/beard acceptable; characteristic moustache, beard and eyebrows; leg hair shorter so true outlines readable. Bushy natural tail rather short, no longer than hock, carried cheerfully outward/upward below vertical with free endpoint, never curled over the back. No curled woolly doodle coat or exaggerated Schnauzer grooming.

profileEvidence.summary: Cheerful and affectionate, the Dutch Smoushond often brings a lively, gentle presence to its people. It tends to enjoy learning and responds best to consistent, gentle handling. Once a carriage follower and stable rat-catcher in the Netherlands, the modern breed was rebuilt from similar-looking dogs after a revival began in 1973.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A cheerful, affectionate Dutch companion, keen to learn with gentle guidance and roots in stable rat-catching.
